title: 31st Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/31/1/2025).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 25/1/2025 to 27/1/2025).

Question from Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to the Minister of Agriculture and Animal Welfare, Dr Mariyam Mariya: why has the cat shelter "Olhuhiyaa", opened on 2 November 2024 for street cats in Malé and Hulhumalé, still not sheltered a single cat; has it been staffed and equipped; and when will street cats be moved there?
First reading of a government bill, sponsored by Dhaandhoo MP Mohamed Fazeel, to amend the Maldives Civil Aviation Authority Act (Law No. 2/2012).
Report of the Judiciary Committee on its review of the Attorney General's Office Bill.
Report of the Judiciary Committee on the Judicial Service Commission's referral, under Article 154(b) of the Constitution, for the removal of Supreme Court Justice Dr Azmiralda Zahir from office.

Report of the Judiciary Committee on the Judicial Service Commission's referral, under Article 154(b) of the Constitution, for the removal of Supreme Court Justice Al-Ustaz Mahaz Ali Zahir from office.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting approved old minutes, questioned the agriculture minister about the empty cat shelter, introduced a Civil Aviation Authority amendment, and took up committee reports on the AG's Office Bill and the removal of two Supreme Court justices.
